$comment: OmniPack fulfilment PRIMARY status vocabulary. Source of truth = the OmniPack API `status` enum documented at https://docs.omnipack.tech (api/v1 + api/v2), reconciled with live stage getFulfilments payloads harvested 2026-07-09 from inbound_provider_events (status/subStatus), and vendor confirmation on 2026-07-24. `observedSubStatuses` keeps its historical field name: entries may be live-observed or explicitly vendor-confirmed. The reconciliation worker maps on the primary `status` only; `subStatus` is recorded verbatim as evidence but never drives the local state. Unknown/UNKNOWN primary statuses quarantine as omnipack_unknown_provider_status. Comparison is on a canonical token (trim, lowercase, [space/_/-]+ -> _). This A->B dictionary is Layer A; every localStatus here MUST land in the cross-layer master map config/fulfillment-status-map.json (verified by src/domains/fulfillment/statusMap.test.ts). See docs/FULFILLMENT_STATUS_CANON.md and omnipackReconciliationWorker.test.ts.

statuses.doc: Fulfilment is new (created or on hold). Its sub-status detail does not prove WMS acceptance, stock coverage, label generation, or literal picking.
Fulfilment is in provider warehouse execution. This maps to coarse warehouse-preparation evidence and does not prove literal picking.
Order picking completed, order is waiting for packing.
statuses.effect: provider_stock_consumed (finished-picking boundary; parity with the order.picked webhook)

statuses.doc: Order is packed and waiting to be taken by courier.
Order is being shipped by courier. Ship boundary: handover + tracking + the 'w drodze' (shipment.dispatched) customer email.
Order delivered to the final receiver.
Order shipping failed - exact reasons have to be determined manually (subStatus DELIVERY_ERROR).
Order not delivered to final receiver, returned to sender.
statuses.effect: fulfillment_exception_hold (ops review / return signal + pre-handoff customer reassurance)

statuses.doc: Provider reports the order cancelled; requires merchant review rather than an automatic local cancellation or refund.
statuses.effect: fulfillment_exception_hold (ops review + pre-handoff customer reassurance; no automatic refund or stock release)

statuses.doc: The order has been suspended pending clarification with merchant. For OUT_OF_STOCK, OmniPack may automatically transition the provider resource to NEW or IN_FULFILLMENT after replenishment; other exit paths are unconfirmed. ERROR only says an error occurred and remains uninterpreted without a versioned nested payload contract.
Status is unknown. Exceptional value, in general it shouldn't happen.
